overview.description: The Harbor AlphaEdge Small Cap Core ETF (AESB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund is actively managed and invests primarily in small-cap companies using fundamental and market-based factors. The fund seeks long-term growth of capital. AESB was launched on Aug 26, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.

holdings.infoBox: AESB is an equity ETF with a total of 168 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple Hospitality REIT stock at 3.09%, First BanCorp. at 3.07%, Bread Financial Holdings at 3.03%, Cathay General Bancorp at 2.43%, and LiveRamp Holdings at 2.43%.
